correctness.rationale: The exact homogeneous decomposition t'=h(s)t² and s'=f(s) is algebraically valid on the positive quadrant, with h bounded positive and projective f increasing toward a unique interior s*. Weighted log-radius series converges uniformly and its cocycle gives a sharp extinction/fixed-point/escape trichotomy, with the critical orbit converging to E in the coexistence chamber. For the new edge theorem g(s)=log(h(s)/h(0))=λs+O(s²) and f(s)=λs(1+O(s)), λ=2b/a. Exit-time comparison and dominated convergence prove λ/(2-λ) for 1<λ<2; summing ≈s over N≈log₂(1/s) terms proves the 1/log2 coefficient at λ=2; positivity of g for λ>2, pre-exit geometric control and one post-exit term give 0<c s^α<=Δ<=C s^α, α=log2/logλ, without claiming a normalized limit. Swap species at other endpoint. Code was read and rational mass identities checked; finite trends do not prove asymptotics.
